resolution.title: [chassis] removed dependency between bgp and swss for chassis supervisor
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/15667 and https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/13293
##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **24472854**:

#### How I did it
On chassis supervisor `bgp` feature is disabled in hostcfgd. The dependency between `swss` and `bgp` causes the bgp containers to start even though the feature is disabled.

#### How to verify it
Tests on chassis supervisor and LC
